QuestInfo.name: One More Debt to Repay
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p402# of #m10003000# has one last favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: #p402# of #m10003000# asked me to deliver his gift to #b#p401##k. Apparently he's too embarrassed to hand it over himself. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k

0.0: So that's it — #p406# saw her old self in me back then. I had no idea. She must've been working just as hard to survive. Kind of embarrassing, honestly. #p406#'s already come so far, and here I am still stuck in the same place.
0.1: Whew, guess I need to step it up too. Oh, and by the way, while you were off with #p406#, I finished a gift for another person I owe thanks to. I think I wrapped this one up a bit more neatly this time. So, would you mind delivering this one for me too?

yes.0: Knew you'd help me out again. Here, just give #b#t4031128##k to #b#p401##k. Surprised that someone with such an unreadable vibe like that ended up helping me out? Honestly, I've always wanted to ask him about it myself sometime. If you get the chance while you're delivering it, I'd love it if you asked about that too.

no.0: Tch, so it's "do your own errands yourself," is it?

1.0: Hmm...? You're #h0#. If you're looking for some good gear, just say the word. Hm? #p402# asked you to deliver a gift he prepared for me? Now that's unexpected.

item.0: Hmm...? You have something for me? Well where is it?

npc.0: I was hoping you'd deliver that gift to #b#p401##k. What? You want me to deliver it myself? If that were an option, I wouldn't have asked you in the first place...

lost.0: Don't tell me you lost the gift I worked so hard to get. Good thing I picked it back up...
